listing.name: ApplyReady Vets
listing.subtitle: Veteran Career Builder
listing.promotional_text: Build an evidence-backed job packet from your resume, service history, and target job posting—privately, with every employer-facing claim under your control.
listing.description:
ApplyReady Vets helps veterans turn verified military and civilian experience into honest, job-specific application materials.

START WITH REAL EVIDENCE
Import your resume, add service experience, and save a target job. The app keeps employer-facing wording tied to information you supplied.

BUILD A COMPLETE JOB PACKET
Create PDF, RTF, and parser-friendly TXT resumes, a LinkedIn copy kit, readiness checks, and an organized application workspace.

PREPARE FOR FEDERAL OR CIVILIAN WORK
Use separate civilian and federal modes, requirement-by-requirement readiness checks, and an offline military-to-civilian occupation crosswalk.

REVIEW BEFORE YOU EXPORT
Truth Lock shows the evidence behind proposed wording and blocks unsupported or sensitive claims from employer-facing export until they are resolved. You remain responsible for every final statement.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
The core workflow runs locally without an account. Optional on-device assistance is used only when available and enabled. This release does not include advertising tracking or a production cloud-AI endpoint.

TRACK THE APPLICATION
Save job links from common job sites, deadlines, notes, required documents, status, and packet versions without logging in to, scraping, or applying through those services.

ONE HONEST PRICE
One complete application workspace is free. ApplyReady Vets Complete is a $5.99 one-time In-App Purchase that unlocks unlimited workspaces. No subscription, ads, credit packs, or export ransom.

ApplyReady Vets is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, Department of Defense, USAJOBS, any military branch, or any employer. It does not provide legal, benefits, disability, eligibility, hiring, or placement decisions, and it cannot guarantee ATS results or employment.

in_app_purchase.description: Unlock unlimited application workspaces with one purchase. The complete first workspace remains free.

review.notes: ApplyReady Vets is an independent veteran career-writing and job-packet utility. No account is required. On first launch, choose Try a safe demo to load synthetic information and exercise Import, Profile, Analysis, Truth Lock, LinkedIn copy, federal checks, tracker, and export without using personal data. The app does not log in to, scrape, publish to, or automate applications on third-party job services. AI assistance is optional; the private deterministic core remains available without it. Every employer-facing export requires candidate review and Truth Lock verification. The app makes no benefits, disability, legal, eligibility, hiring, placement, or ATS guarantee. The free tier includes one complete workspace. ApplyReady Vets Complete is the only consumer purchase and unlocks unlimited workspaces. Use the visible Complete screen to test purchase and Settings > Restore Purchases to test restore. Submit the first non-consumable with this app version. The app is not affiliated with or endorsed by VA, DoD, USAJOBS, any military branch, Apple, any job platform, or any employer. No production external-service endpoint is configured in this Release build.
